funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Author Grants

amount.raw: Tiered: Small up to £2,000; Large from £2,001 to £6,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals at any stage of career; must be author or editor of the proposed publication and have a publisher confirmed with a publication date within three years.
opportunities.summary: Financial support for individuals seeking to disseminate research on British art through the publication of monographs, edited collections, catalogues and articles, covering practical publishing costs such as image licensing and reproduction.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Research Project Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any organisation, institution or nonprofit; collaborative applications welcomed; one Research Project Grant per round per organisation.
opportunities.summary: Flexible financial support for organisations undertaking ambitious and sustained research in the field of British art, designed primarily to support staff costs towards a research project with public-facing outcomes and/or legacy.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Exhibition Publication Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any organisation, institution or nonprofit; the exhibition on which the publication is based may be forthcoming or already taken place.
opportunities.summary: Support for organisations to produce publications related to their exhibitions and displays, covering practical publishing costs such as image and production costs.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Event Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any organisation, institution or nonprofit; collaborative applications welcomed.
opportunities.summary: Support for organisations to disseminate research on British art through live, online and hybrid events intended for a variety of audiences, covering costs such as venue hire, accommodation for speakers and staffing.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Conservation Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any organisation, institution or nonprofit undertaking a conservation research project or technical analysis; items supported must be in public or charitable ownership and accessible to the public.
opportunities.summary: Support for organisations to protect and preserve significant works of British art by undertaking original and needed conservation research, covering staff and equipment costs.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Digitisation Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any organisation, institution or nonprofit undertaking work to digitise items and material in their own collections relating to British art.
opportunities.summary: Support for organisations to make their collections freely available to audiences online via digitisation, covering personnel and equipment costs.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Emerging Researchers in British Art (ERBA) Opportunity: Research Travel Bursaries
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must be a Member of ERBA (Emerging Researchers in British Art); membership can be pending at application.
opportunities.summary: Research travel bursaries for ERBA members to support a specific trip, such as visiting a library, archive, collection or site, covering transport, accommodation and reasonable expenses.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Individual Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals at any stage of career for grants up to £8,000; the £8,001-£20,000 tier requires postdoctoral level or equivalent research experience. Open to international applicants.
opportunities.summary: Flexible financial support for individuals to undertake research travel and/or take time to address specific research questions in the field of British art.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Study Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals enrolled to start (with a place confirmed), or already undertaking, a master's level or doctorate level degree in the field of British art, visual culture or architecture.
opportunities.summary: Financial support for students beginning or continuing a master's or doctoral degree who may face barriers in undertaking their course of study.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Andrew Wyld Research Support Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Registered students at undergraduate level and above, from any country.
opportunities.summary: Flexible financial support for registered students to undertake research trips to examine works on paper (prints, drawings, watercolours) from the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries firsthand, drawn from the Andrew Wyld Fund.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Master's Degree Scholarship

amount.raw: Total of £32,000 for one year, or split over two years if part time

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals who have applied for or are in receipt of an offer of a master's degree place (MA, MPhil, MSc or equivalent) at a UK-based institution, due to begin between April 2027 and April 2028.
opportunities.summary: Full funding to support a master's degree that will bring new perspectives to the understanding of British art, part of the New Narratives scheme to increase diversity of perspectives.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Doctoral Scholarship

amount.raw: Total of £96,000 awarded as £32,000 a year for three years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals who have applied for, or are in receipt of, an offer of a doctorate degree place at a UK-based institution, due to begin between April 2027 and April 2028. International applicants not qualifying for home fees may apply but must source additional funding.
opportunities.summary: Funding to support doctoral research that will expand understanding of British art through new perspectives, paying university fees and living expenses, part of the New Narratives scheme.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: New Narratives: Early Career Fellowship

amount.raw: One year at £35,000, or two years at a total of £70,000 (paid at £35,000 per year)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Individuals at postdoctoral level (or with equivalent experience) or above.
opportunities.summary: Financial support for individuals to undertake a major project in the field of British art that will reshape understanding of the field, part of the New Narratives scheme.

opportunities.funder: Paul Mellon Centre for Studies in British Art
opportunities.title: Rome Fellowship

amount.raw: Full board and accommodation at the British School at Rome for three months, as well as an honorarium

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Scholars, researchers, curators, archivists and GLAM professionals with at least a first degree, from pre-doctoral PhD candidates to those internationally recognised in their field.
opportunities.summary: A three-month residency at the British School at Rome for individuals undertaking advanced research relating to cultural contact, exchange and influence between Britain and Italy.
